The exact reviewed status and dependencies are recorded at the end.
The classical SSEP action and its large-deviation machinery
are not new. The issue here is their validity for the actual selectively
actuated family, with arbitrary bounded nonlocal frozen amplitudes.

diffusion of physical strength kappa_N tending to infinity. Observe
physical time N^2 T. Independent local sign flips with gamma_N tending
to infinity are a separately supplied alternative. The deterministic
initial occupancies have empirical profile m dx, 0<m<1; phases/signs
and the old retained record can be arbitrary within the stated fresh
future-noise interface.

# Control granularity can be exchanged for clock bandwidth

29 October 2026. Root's constructive continuation after the independent
action theorem and conserving common-clock counterexample. This gives
the stronger ordinary implementation rather than treating independent
ports as the only possible supplier. All previous source distinctions
and actual operation costs remain in force.

## 1. Actual grouped operation

Partition the N bonds into nonempty groups G_g of sizes n_g. There is
one orientation sigma_g in {-1,+1} per group. A supplied clock flips
all kinetic orientations in that group simultaneously at physical
rate gamma_g, leaving occupancies and frozen z unchanged. The group
clocks have independent fresh innovations. Native rates are

    r_i=(s/2)[1+beta_i(eta,z)sigma_(g(i))],
    |beta_i|<=1, beta_i(eta^i,z)=beta_i(eta,z).          (1)

This is an actual selective operation menu, not a decomposition of
one observed kernel into fictitious controls. Amplitudes can be
arbitrarily nonlocal, and native zero rates are permitted. The common
mean s is supplied/warranted as in the other constructions.

The full reference density/current action in
`CONTROLLED_MACROSCOPIC_ACTION.md` holds if

    r_N := max_g n_g/gamma_g ->0.                      (2)

The same fixed deterministic initial-profile sequence, physical horizon
N^2T, initial-record scope and actual-noise premises apply. Conditional
on an old record, the complete future native-and-clock generator must
remain the declared law; clock freshness alone is insufficient if the
record exposes future native innovations. Every initial joint
occupancy/orientation law is dominated by 2^(N+#groups) times its
uniform product reference, at most 4^N. No orientation key needs to
be forgotten or initially randomized.

## 2. Exponential phase cancellation

For a current test, write the unwanted drift as

    H_N=sum_g sigma_g v_g(eta,z),
    v_g=sum_(i in G_g) v_i, ||v_i||_infinity<=C.        (3)

The sign identity, weighted Cauchy--Schwarz and completion of squares
against N^2 sum_g gamma_g D_g give

    log E_mu exp[bN int_0^T H_Ndt]
        <=(b^2 T/2)sum_g ||v_g||_infinity^2/gamma_g
        <=(C^2 b^2 T/2)sum_g n_g^2/gamma_g
        <=(C^2 b^2 T/2)N r_N.                         (4)

The native reversible form is nonnegative and was discarded in this
estimate. No amplitude derivative or locality estimate is used.

# Matching rare-transport law for the conserving common-clock family

29 October 2026. Root follow-on receiving theorem. This closes the
scalar lower-bound gap left by the earlier common-clock upper bound,
at an explicitly warranted canonical initial law. It does not prove
the proposed full nonlocal density/current action.

## 1. Result and actual initialization

Use the even-N conserving ring

    r_i=c(1+alpha u delta_i), c=s/2, 0<alpha<1,
    u=sigma p(eta), p=(-1)^(sum_i i eta_i),
    delta_i=eta_i-eta_(i+1), A=sum_i delta_i^2.           (1)

One actual common Poisson clock flips sigma at physical rate gamma_N,
with gamma_N->infinity and gamma_N/N->0. Initialize occupancies from
the uniform canonical law with exactly M_N particles, M_N/N->m in
(0,1), and initialize sigma independently and fairly. Denote this
stationary joint law by mu_N. It is an actual initial-law premise;
this theorem does not supply its preparation or erase its retained
records. Conditional use requires that law, or the explicit additional
initial entropy condition discussed below, and the complete declared
future native-and-clock generator.

For Q_N=J(N^2T)/N^2, the scalar LDP at speed N has rate

    I_T^common(q)=q^2/[2s chi(m)(1-alpha^2)T].            (2)

Its scaled cumulant generating function is

    lim_N N^-1 log E exp[N lambda Q_N]
       =(s/2)chi(m)(1-alpha^2)T lambda^2.                (3)

The existing upper bound holds even for arbitrary deterministic
initial occupancies of the same asymptotic mass. The new lower proof
here is canonical-initial; it does not silently extend that upper
bound to a matching deterministic-initial theorem.

visible law and record every initial orientation as +1. The common

bound uses only the conserved mass, and its weak-tilt lower receiver
needs initial empirical convergence in probability to the flat profile,
which the canonical law supplies. The same uniform phase/occupation
estimates and martingale identification establish that receiver.
